name: ACL Live at The Moody Theater

bagPolicy.summary: No backpacks or large bags over 11”x17” are allowed. Diaper and medical bags are permitted.
bagPolicy.note: Diaper and medical bags are permitted.

parking.note: The venue has no official parking. Use nearby garages or surface lots. W Hotel valet is available to ticketholders on a first-come basis. Advance parking reservations are available through the linked SpotHero service.

rideshare.note: Rideshare is recommended to avoid parking delays and traffic downtown. Lyft is the venue's official rideshare partner.

concessions.note: Concessions and bars accept credit cards, debit cards and mobile payments only. Bring ID to buy alcohol. Outside food and drinks are prohibited.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is available on every level. The street-level elevator beside the box office reaches all levels. Wheelchair storage is available during concerts. Email info@acllive.com for accommodations.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is generally allowed with your ticket and another security check. Shows that prohibit re-entry are marked at the entrance.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Will Call
ticketPickup.body: The box office is on 2nd Street between Lavaca and Guadalupe, beside the venue store. It opens on event days one hour before doors. Bring ID for will call. Paper tickets are not accepted at entry.

gates.title: Entrance & Doors
gates.body: Have your tickets ready in the AXS app. Arrive at least 30 minutes before showtime for security screening.
